title: Blur swap
summary: Replaces content in place by blurring the old out as the new sharpens in, as the mobile app does. Use it for icon swaps, labels that change in place and counters.

demos.title: Icon swap
demos.note: Change swapKey when the content changes. The old icon softens and shrinks out as the new one sharpens in. Press the button.

demos.title: Label that changes in place

demos.title: Counter
demos.note: A number as the swapKey: every change resolves into the next value. With reduced motion it is a plain fade.
